Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: After identifying a conflict in Carl Boese’s birth year (1887 vs 1897) at step 9 and receiving instructions to resolve it via authoritative sources (e.g., German Wikipedia, filmportal.de), WebSurfer ignored this unresolved crucial point and instead repeatedly re-searched Fritz Lang’s birth date. This failure to follow the plan and verify Boese’s correct birth year could lead to adopting the erroneous 1897 date and thus the wrong conclusion about which director was born first.
